reason: Qualified sentences added so the planning guidance is true for both kinds of project: scopes sit below the project's tenant on an Engine project (ES-9), the server-side module-access check goes through /api/permissions/me there (ES-16), and a cron job's body and schedule there follow the Engine's runtime (ES-10, ES-13n); the Supabase guidance is unchanged.
Names where the collection schema is stored on each kind of project (the DaaS, or the Engine).

Engine statement ES-16 reworded: the OAuth routes that cannot be used on an Engine project are those of the external-oauth module, and the external-oauth-engine module's routes serve My Apps sign-in; the Supabase guidance is unchanged.
Engine statement ES-16 names the identity provider product XAppHub (formerly My Apps); the module names and the Supabase guidance are unchanged.
The Engine-project sentence about cron jobs (ES-13n, retired) now says that an active cron job fires at its scheduled time (ES-13m); the Supabase guidance is unchanged.

Engine statement ES-9 reworded: on an Engine project scope types, items and collection settings are also managed through the MCP scope tool, whose reads follow the caller's grants and whose writes are for administrators, with the routes for an Engine older than 0.1.0-dev.19; the Supabase guidance is unchanged.
